# MathDB claim notification templates

Use the configured official MathDB sender. Do not post filled email templates or
addresses in public issues. Persist a stable private mail-task ID and provider
result, and track bounces separately from initial sending-service acceptance.

## Initial notification

```text
From: MathDB <configured official sender>
To: <contributor's registered private email>
Cc: thejustinsunprize@hejustinsun.com
Reply-To: thejustinsunprize@hejustinsun.com
Subject: [Claim Reward][MathDB] JSP-XXXXXX / issue #N / claim handoff

Your <categories and exact versions> passed the relevant technical review and
preliminary reward-condition checks. You may enter the reward-claim process;
the prize team determines final qualification.

Problem and MathDB page: <JSP, title and URL>
Reviewed versions and conclusions: <category records and UTC times>
Qualification evidence: <Solution/Lean original date after 2026-01-01 and earliest
valid contribution evidence; or Exposition committee first-satisfactory decision>
Created/updated claim: <issue URL>
Solution complete-Lean payment condition, if applicable: <verified / explicitly
adopted external evidence / awaiting valid evidence>

Please review the issue and reply personally to the prize mailbox, linking it,
confirming your own contribution and intent to claim, and disclosing coauthors
and related claims. Supply an independently verifiable identity method privately.
After the team determines the proposed categories, reward and public attribution,
confirm those terms again in writing. Payment details are requested separately.

The agent only hands off your materials. Review and notification do not award a
reward: team review, 14 days from each category's actual candidate publication,
resolved objections, identity and personal confirmation, and applicable payment
conditions remain required. Category shares are 50% Solution, 30% Lean and 20%
Exposition; individual allocations are determined by the team.

Keep private identity, payment and delivery information out of public issues.
This notification is from MathDB. Official prize-team mail comes from
@hejustinsun.com. The team never requests private keys or seed phrases.
```

## Supplement, new category or changed conclusion

Use the same claim thread and Cc/Reply-To. State the JSP/claim URL, affected
category and versions, new evidence/withdrawal, UTC date, consequence, required
personal action and next responsible party. No success notification for a category
with missing qualification evidence. A withdrawal notice must explain holds on
related Solution payments when complete Lean evidence is affected.

## Personal response

```text
To: thejustinsunprize@hejustinsun.com
Subject: [Claim Reward] JSP-XXXXXX / issue #N

Claim and public MathDB profile: <links>
Categories and reviewed versions: <details>
My specific contribution, collaborators and related claims: <details>
Proposed independently verifiable identity method: <method and private evidence>

I confirm that I am applying for my own stated contribution and wish to claim.
I have disclosed collaborators, citations and related records. I understand that
technical acceptance and preliminary checks are not an award, and that team
review, category public review, identity, personal confirmation and applicable
payment conditions remain required. I will separately confirm the team's
determined categories, reward and public attribution when requested.
```
